messages.author: e7c7ced561265a1f
messages.subject: rescaling covariates in mcds
parts:
Hi all,

I am adding covariates to detection function models within mrds, and I've
just noticed that if I rescale numerical covariates so as to always fall
between 0 and 1 I can get models to fit successfully where previously they
fell over. I include a code excerpt below which illustrates this behaviour
for two numerical covariates (cluster size and body length).



So, from now on I will rescale all my covariates, but wondering if this
represents a bug in the code, or if I'm failing to set some option which
would avoid this behaviour.



Best wishes





Nigel





Dr Nigel Harding

messages.author: 350dad0a615d36db
messages.subject: Re: rescaling covariates in mcds
parts:
Dear Nigel, list,

This is a known issue and does not necessarily represent a "bug", as
such. I have written some information about optimisation issues
(regarding my Distance package, but this extends to mrds too), which can
be found here:

https://github.com/dill/Distance/wiki/OptimisationIssues

I hope this helps!

best,
--dave
